answer: A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. The copper is that the door answers to Accredited linen weaver court bond alone, and a bond weavers post after shuttle trials is the lock it turns. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. Nobody is waved through free: £12 in fees and a 7-day delay before the stamp dries is the price, and the island never covers it twice. Every tide is counted once.
